attributes.name: aria-activedescendant
attributes.description: Identifies the currently active element when DOM focus is on a composite widget, combobox, textbox, group, or application.

attributes.name: aria-atomic
attributes.description: Indicates whether assistive technologies will present all, or only parts of, the changed region based on the change notifications defined by the aria-relevant attribute.

attributes.name: aria-autocomplete
attributes.description: Indicates whether inputting text could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's intended value for a combobox, searchbox, or textbox and specifies how predictions would be presented if they were made.

attributes.name: aria-braillelabel
attributes.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element, which is intended to be converted into Braille. See related aria-label.

attributes.name: aria-brailleroledescription
attributes.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized abbreviated description for the role of an element, which is intended to be converted into Braille. See related aria-roledescription.

attributes.name: aria-busy
attributes.description: Indicates an element is being modified and that assistive technologies could wait until the modifications are complete before exposing them to the user.

attributes.name: aria-checked
attributes.description: Indicates the current "checked" state of checkboxes, radio buttons, and other widgets. See related aria-pressed and aria-selected.

attributes.name: aria-colcount
attributes.description: Defines the total number of columns in a table, grid, or treegrid. See related aria-colindex.

attributes.name: aria-colindex
attributes.description: Defines an element's column index or position with respect to the total number of columns within a table, grid, or treegrid. See related aria-colindextext, aria-colcount, and aria-colspan.

attributes.name: aria-colindextext
attributes.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-colindex. See related aria-rowindextext.

attributes.name: aria-colspan
attributes.description: Defines the number of columns spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid. See related aria-colindex and aria-rowspan.

attributes.name: aria-controls
attributes.description: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the focused element or composite widget. See related aria-details and aria-owns.

attributes.name: aria-current
attributes.description: Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related elements.

attributes.name: aria-describedby
attributes.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object. See related aria-labelledby and aria-description.

attributes.name: aria-description
attributes.description: Defines a string value that describes or annotates the current element. See related aria-describedby.

attributes.name: aria-details
attributes.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that provide additional information related to the object. See related aria-describedby.

attributes.name: aria-disabled
attributes.description: Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise operable. See related aria-hidden and aria-readonly.

attributes.name: aria-dropeffect
attributes.description: Indicates what functions can be performed when a dragged object is released on the drop target.

attributes.name: aria-errormessage
attributes.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that provides an error message for an object. See related aria-invalid and aria-describedby.

attributes.name: aria-expanded
attributes.description: Indicates whether a related element is expanded (shown) or collapsed (hidden).

attributes.name: aria-flowto
attributes.description: Identifies the next element (or elements) in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion, allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in document source order.

attributes.name: aria-grabbed
attributes.description: Indicates an element's "grabbed" state in a drag-and-drop operation.

attributes.name: aria-haspopup
attributes.description: Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that can be triggered by an element.

attributes.name: aria-hidden
attributes.description: Indicates, when set to true, that an element and its entire subtree are hidden from assistive technology, regardless of whether it is visibly rendered.

attributes.name: aria-invalid
attributes.description: Indicates the entered value does not conform to the format expected by the application. See related aria-errormessage.

attributes.name: aria-keyshortcuts
attributes.description: Defines keyboard shortcuts that an author has implemented to activate or give focus to an element.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element. See related aria-labelledby.

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element. See related aria-label and aria-describedby.

attributes.name: aria-level
attributes.description: Defines the hierarchical level of an element within a structure.

attributes.name: aria-live
attributes.description: Indicates that an element will be updated or modified, and defines the priority of updates the user agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

attributes.name: aria-modal
attributes.description: Indicates whether an element is modal when displayed.

attributes.name: aria-multiline
attributes.description: Indicates whether a text box accepts multiple lines of input or only a single line.

attributes.name: aria-multiselectable
attributes.description: Indicates that the user can select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.

attributes.name: aria-orientation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous.

attributes.name: aria-owns
attributes.description: Identifies an element (or elements) in order to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship between DOM elements where the DOM hierarchy cannot be used to represent the relationship. See related aria-controls.

attributes.name: aria-placeholder
attributes.description: Defines a short hint (a word or short phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value. A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected format.

attributes.name: aria-posinset
attributes.description: Defines an element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM. See related aria-setsize.

attributes.name: aria-pressed
attributes.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons. See related aria-checked and aria-selected.

attributes.name: aria-readonly
attributes.description: Indicates that the element is not editable, but is otherwise operable. See related aria-disabled.

attributes.name: aria-relevant
attributes.description: Indicates what notifications the user agent will trigger when the accessibility tree within a live region is modified. See related aria-atomic.

attributes.name: aria-required
attributes.description: Indicates that user input is required on the element before a form can be submitted.

attributes.name: aria-roledescription
attributes.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized description for the role of an element.

attributes.name: aria-rowcount
attributes.description: Defines the total number of rows in a table, grid, or treegrid. See related aria-rowindex.

attributes.name: aria-rowindex
attributes.description: Defines an element's row index or position with respect to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid. See related aria-rowindextext, aria-rowcount, and aria-rowspan.

attributes.name: aria-rowindextext
attributes.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-rowindex. See related aria-colindextext.

attributes.name: aria-rowspan
attributes.description: Defines the number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid. See related aria-rowindex and aria-colspan.

attributes.name: aria-selected
attributes.description: Indicates the current "selected" state of various widgets. See related aria-checked and aria-pressed.

attributes.name: aria-setsize
attributes.description: Defines the number of items in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM. See related aria-posinset.

attributes.name: aria-sort
attributes.description: Indicates if items in a table or grid are sorted in ascending or descending order.

attributes.name: aria-valuemax
attributes.description: Defines the maximum allowed value for a range widget.

attributes.name: aria-valuemin
attributes.description: Defines the minimum allowed value for a range widget.

attributes.name: aria-valuenow
attributes.description: Defines the current value for a range widget. See related aria-valuetext.

attributes.name: aria-valuetext
attributes.description: Defines the human readable text alternative of aria-valuenow for a range widget.

roles.name: alert
roles.description: A type of live region with important, and usually time-sensitive, information. See related alertdialog and status.

roles.name: alertdialog
roles.description: A type of dialog that contains an alert message, where initial focus goes to an element within the dialog. See related alert and dialog.

roles.name: application
roles.description: A structure containing one or more focusable elements requiring user input, such as keyboard or gesture events, that do not follow a standard interaction pattern supported by a widget role.

roles.name: article
roles.description: A section of a page that consists of a composition that forms an independent part of a document, page, or site.

roles.name: banner
roles.description: A landmark that contains mostly site-oriented content, rather than page-specific content.

roles.name: blockquote
roles.description: A section of content that is quoted from another source.

roles.name: button
roles.description: An input that allows for user-triggered actions when clicked or pressed. See related link.

roles.name: caption
roles.description: Visible content that names, or describes a figure, grid, group, radiogroup, table or treegrid.

roles.name: cell
roles.description: A cell in a tabular container. See related gridcell.

roles.name: checkbox
roles.description: A checkable input that has three possible values: true, false, or mixed.

roles.name: code
roles.description: A section whose content represents a fragment of computer code.

roles.name: columnheader
roles.description: A cell containing header information for a column.

roles.name: combobox
roles.description: An input that controls another element, such as a listbox or grid, that can dynamically pop up to help the user set the value of the input.

roles.name: command
roles.description: A form of widget that performs an action but does not receive input data.

roles.name: comment
roles.description: A comment contains content expressing reaction to other content.

roles.name: complementary
roles.description: A landmark that is designed to be complementary to the main content that it is a sibling to, or a direct descendant of. The contents of a complementary landmark would be expected to remain meaningful if it were to be separated from the main content it is relevant to.

roles.name: composite
roles.description: A widget that can contain navigable accessibility descendants.

roles.name: contentinfo
roles.description: A landmark that contains information about the parent document.

roles.name: definition
roles.description: A definition of a term or concept. See related term.

roles.name: deletion
roles.description: A deletion represents content that is marked as removed, content that is being suggested for removal, or content that is no longer relevant in the context of its accompanying content. See related insertion.

roles.name: dialog
roles.description: A dialog is a descendant window of the primary window of a web application. For HTML pages, the primary application window is the entire web document.

roles.name: directory
roles.description: A list of references to members of a group, such as a static table of contents.

roles.name: doc-abstract
roles.description: A short summary of the principal ideas, concepts, and conclusions of the work, or of a section or excerpt within it.

roles.name: doc-acknowledgments
roles.description: A section or statement that acknowledges significant contributions by persons, organizations, governments, and other entities to the realization of the work.

roles.name: doc-afterword
roles.description: A closing statement from the author or a person of importance, typically providing insight into how the content came to be written, its significance, or related events that have transpired since its timeline.

roles.name: doc-appendix
roles.description: A section of supplemental information located after the primary content that informs the content but is not central to it.

roles.name: doc-backlink
roles.description: A link that allows the user to return to a related location in the content (e.g., from a footnote to its reference or from a glossary definition to where a term is used).

roles.name: doc-biblioentry
roles.description: A single reference to an external source in a bibliography. A biblioentry typically provides more detailed information than its reference(s) in the content (e.g., full title, author(s), publisher, publication date, etc.).

roles.name: doc-bibliography
roles.description: A list of external references cited in the work, which could be to print or digital sources.

roles.name: doc-biblioref
roles.description: A reference to a bibliography entry.

roles.name: doc-chapter
roles.description: A major thematic section of content in a work.

roles.name: doc-colophon
roles.description: A short section of production notes particular to the edition (e.g., describing the typeface used), often located at the end of a work.

roles.name: doc-conclusion
roles.description: A concluding section or statement that summarizes the work or wraps up the narrative.

roles.name: doc-cover
roles.description: An image that sets the mood or tone for the work and typically includes the title and author.

roles.name: doc-credit
roles.description: An acknowledgment of the source of integrated content from third-party sources, such as photos. Typically identifies the creator, copyright, and any restrictions on reuse.

roles.name: doc-credits
roles.description: A collection of credits.

roles.name: doc-dedication
roles.description: An inscription at the front of the work, typically addressed in tribute to one or more persons close to the author.

roles.name: doc-endnote
roles.description: One of a collection of notes that occur at the end of a work, or a section within it, that provides additional context to a referenced passage of text.

roles.name: doc-endnotes
roles.description: A collection of notes at the end of a work or a section within it.

roles.name: doc-epigraph
roles.description: A quotation set at the start of the work or a section that establishes the theme or sets the mood.

roles.name: doc-epilogue
roles.description: A concluding section of narrative that wraps up or comments on the actions and events of the work, typically from a future perspective.

roles.name: doc-errata
roles.description: A set of corrections discovered after initial publication of the work, sometimes referred to as corrigenda.

roles.name: doc-example
roles.description: An illustration of a key concept of the work, such as a code listing, case study or problem.

roles.name: doc-footnote
roles.description: Ancillary information, such as a citation or commentary, that provides additional context to a referenced passage of text.

roles.name: doc-foreword
roles.description: An introductory section that precedes the work, typically not written by the author of the work.

roles.name: doc-glossary
roles.description: A brief dictionary of new, uncommon, or specialized terms used in the content.

roles.name: doc-glossref
roles.description: A reference to a glossary definition.

roles.name: doc-index
roles.description: A navigational aid that provides a detailed list of links to key subjects, names and other important topics covered in the work.

roles.name: doc-introduction
roles.description: A preliminary section that typically introduces the scope or nature of the work.

roles.name: doc-noteref
roles.description: A reference to a footnote or endnote, typically appearing as a superscripted number or symbol in the main body of text.

roles.name: doc-notice
roles.description: Notifies the user of consequences that might arise from an action or event. Examples include warnings, cautions and dangers.

roles.name: doc-pagebreak
roles.description: A separator denoting the position before which a break occurs between two contiguous pages in a statically paginated version of the content.

roles.name: doc-pagefooter
roles.description: A section of text appearing at the bottom of a page that provides context about the current work and location within it. The page footer is distinct from the body text and normally follows a repeating template that contains (possibly truncated) items such as the document title, current section, author name(s), and page number.

roles.name: doc-pageheader
roles.description: A section of text appearing at the top of a page that provides context about the current work and location within it. The page header is distinct from the body text and normally follows a repeating template that contains (possibly truncated) items such as the document title, current section, author name(s), and page number.

roles.name: doc-pagelist
roles.description: A navigational aid that provides a list of links to the page breaks in the content.

roles.name: doc-part
roles.description: A major structural division in a work that contains a set of related sections dealing with a particular subject, narrative arc, or similar encapsulated theme.

roles.name: doc-preface
roles.description: An introductory section that precedes the work, typically written by the author of the work.

roles.name: doc-prologue
roles.description: An introductory section that sets the background to a work, typically part of the narrative.

roles.name: doc-pullquote
roles.description: A distinctively placed or highlighted quotation from the current content designed to draw attention to a topic or highlight a key point.

roles.name: doc-qna
roles.description: A section of content structured as a series of questions and answers, such as an interview or list of frequently asked questions.

roles.name: doc-subtitle
roles.description: An explanatory or alternate title for the work, or a section or component within it.

roles.name: doc-tip
roles.description: Helpful information that clarifies some aspect of the content or assists in its comprehension.

roles.name: doc-toc
roles.description: A navigational aid that provides an ordered list of links to the major sectional headings in the content. A table of contents could cover an entire work or only a smaller section of it.

roles.name: document
roles.description: An element containing content that assistive technology users might want to browse in a reading mode.

roles.name: emphasis
roles.description: One or more emphasized characters. See related strong.

roles.name: feed
roles.description: A scrollable list of articles where scrolling might cause articles to be added to or removed from either end of the list.

roles.name: figure
roles.description: A perceivable section of content that typically contains a graphical document, images, media player, code snippets, or example text. The parts of a figure MAY be user-navigable.

roles.name: form
roles.description: A landmark region that contains a collection of items and objects that, as a whole, combine to create a form. See related search.

roles.name: generic
roles.description: A nameless container element that has no semantic meaning on its own.

roles.name: graphics-document
roles.description: A type of document in which the visual appearance or layout of content conveys meaning.

roles.name: graphics-object
roles.description: A section of a graphics-document that represents a distinct object or sub-component with semantic meaning. A graphical object may itself have nested sub-components.

roles.name: graphics-symbol
roles.description: A graphical object used to convey a simple meaning or category, where the meaning is more important than the particular visual appearance. It may be a component of a larger structured graphic such as a chart or map. The symbol itself is an atomic object; children are presentational.

roles.name: grid
roles.description: A composite widget containing a collection of one or more rows with one or more cells where some or all cells in the grid are focusable by using methods of two-dimensional navigation, such as directional arrow keys.

roles.name: gridcell
roles.description: A cell in a grid or treegrid.

roles.name: group
roles.description: A set of user interface objects and information that is not intended to be included in a page summary or table of contents by assistive technologies.

roles.name: heading
roles.description: A heading for a section of the page.

roles.name: image
roles.description: A container for a collection of elements that form an image. See synonym img.

roles.name: img
roles.description: A container for a collection of elements that form an image. See synonym image.

roles.name: input
roles.description: A generic type of widget that allows user input.

roles.name: insertion
roles.description: An insertion contains content that is marked as added or content that is being suggested for addition. See related deletion.

roles.name: landmark
roles.description: A perceivable section containing content that is relevant to a specific, author-specified purpose and sufficiently important that users will likely want to be able to navigate to the section easily and to have it listed in a summary of the page. Such a page summary could be generated dynamically by a user agent or assistive technology.

roles.name: link
roles.description: An interactive reference to an internal or external resource that, when activated, causes the user agent to navigate to that resource. See related button.

roles.name: list
roles.description: A section containing listitem elements. See related listbox.

roles.name: listbox
roles.description: A widget that allows the user to select one or more items from a list of choices. See related combobox and list.

roles.name: listitem
roles.description: A single item in a list or directory.

roles.name: log
roles.description: A type of live region where new information is added in meaningful order and old information can disappear.

roles.name: main
roles.description: A landmark containing the main content of a document.

roles.name: mark
roles.description: Content which is marked or highlighted for reference or notation purposes, due to the content's relevance in the enclosing context.

roles.name: marquee
roles.description: A section of content where non-essential information changes frequently.

roles.name: math
roles.description: Content that represents a mathematical expression.

roles.name: menu
roles.description: A type of widget that offers a list of choices to the user.

roles.name: menubar
roles.description: A presentation of menu that usually remains visible and is usually presented horizontally.

roles.name: menuitem
roles.description: An option in a set of choices contained by a menu or menubar.

roles.name: menuitemcheckbox
roles.description: A menuitem with a checkable state whose possible values are true, false, or mixed.

roles.name: menuitemradio
roles.description: A checkable menuitem in a set of elements with the same role, only one of which can be checked at a time.

roles.name: meter
roles.description: An element that represents a scalar measurement within a known range, or a fractional value. See related progressbar.

roles.name: navigation
roles.description: A landmark containing a collection of navigational elements (usually links) for navigating the document or related documents.

roles.name: none
roles.description: An element whose implicit native role semantics will not be mapped to the accessibility API. See synonym presentation.

roles.name: note
roles.description: A section whose content represents additional information or parenthetical context to the primary content it supplements.

roles.name: option
roles.description: An item in a listbox.

roles.name: paragraph
roles.description: A paragraph of content.

roles.name: presentation
roles.description: An element whose implicit native role semantics will not be mapped to the accessibility API. See synonym none.

roles.name: progressbar
roles.description: An element that displays the progress status for tasks that take a long time.

roles.name: radio
roles.description: A checkable input in a group of elements with the same role, only one of which can be checked at a time.

roles.name: radiogroup
roles.description: A group of radio buttons.

roles.name: range
roles.description: An element representing a range of values.

roles.name: region
roles.description: A landmark containing content that is relevant to a specific, author-specified purpose and sufficiently important that users will likely want to be able to navigate to the section easily and to have it listed in a summary of the page. Such a page summary could be generated dynamically by a user agent or assistive technology.

roles.name: roletype
roles.description: The base role from which all other roles inherit.

roles.name: row
roles.description: A row of cells in a tabular container.

roles.name: rowgroup
roles.description: A structure containing one or more row elements in a tabular container.

roles.name: rowheader
roles.description: A cell containing header information for a row.

roles.name: scrollbar
roles.description: A graphical object that controls the scrolling of content within a viewing area, regardless of whether the content is fully displayed within the viewing area.

roles.name: search
roles.description: A landmark region that contains a collection of items and objects that, as a whole, combine to create a search facility. See related form and searchbox.

roles.name: searchbox
roles.description: A type of textbox intended for specifying search criteria. See related textbox and search.

roles.name: section
roles.description: A renderable structural containment unit on a page.

roles.name: sectionfooter
roles.description: A set of user interface objects and information representing information about its closest ancestral content group. For instance, a sectionfooter can include information about who wrote the specific section of content, such as an article. It can contain links to related documents, copyright information or other indices and colophon specific to the current section of the page.

roles.name: sectionhead
roles.description: A structure that labels or summarizes the topic of its related section.

roles.name: sectionheader
roles.description: A set of user interface objects and information that represents a collection of introductory items for the element's closest ancestral content group. For instance, a sectionheader can include the heading, introductory statement and related meta data for a section of content, for instance a region or article, within a web page.

roles.name: select
roles.description: A form widget that allows the user to make selections from a set of choices.

roles.name: separator
roles.description: A divider that separates and distinguishes sections of content or groups of menuitems.

roles.name: slider
roles.description: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.

roles.name: spinbutton
roles.description: A form of range that expects the user to select from among discrete choices.

roles.name: status
roles.description: A type of live region whose content is advisory information for the user but is not important enough to justify an alert, often but not necessarily presented as a status bar.

roles.name: strong
roles.description: Content that is important, serious, or urgent. See related emphasis.

roles.name: structure
roles.description: A document structural element.

roles.name: subscript
roles.description: One or more subscripted characters. See related superscript.

roles.name: suggestion
roles.description: A single proposed change to content.

roles.name: superscript
roles.description: One or more superscripted characters. See related subscript.

roles.name: switch
roles.description: A type of checkbox that represents on/off values, as opposed to checked/unchecked values. See related checkbox.

roles.name: tab
roles.description: A grouping label providing a mechanism for selecting the tab content that is to be rendered to the user.

roles.name: table
roles.description: A section containing data arranged in rows and columns. See related grid.

roles.name: tablist
roles.description: A list of tab elements, which are references to tabpanel elements.

roles.name: tabpanel
roles.description: A container for the resources associated with a tab, where each tab is contained in a tablist.

roles.name: term
roles.description: A word or phrase with an optional corresponding definition. See related definition.

roles.name: textbox
roles.description: A type of input that allows free-form text as its value.

roles.name: time
roles.description: An element that represents a specific point in time.

roles.name: timer
roles.description: A section of content containing a numerical counter which indicates an amount of elapsed time from a start point, or the time remaining until an end point.

roles.name: toolbar
roles.description: A collection of commonly used function buttons or controls represented in compact visual form.

roles.name: tooltip
roles.description: A contextual popup that displays a description for an element.

roles.name: tree
roles.description: A widget that allows the user to select one or more items from a hierarchically organized collection.

roles.name: treegrid
roles.description: A grid whose rows can be expanded and collapsed in the same manner as for a tree.

roles.name: treeitem
roles.description: An item in a tree.

roles.name: widget
roles.description: An interactive component of a graphical user interface (GUI).

roles.name: window
roles.description: A browser or application window.
